name: ui-state-architect-board
description: StateArchitectBoard — visual state-machine graph editor: wire transitions between state nodes so every test case reaches its expected state.

schema.name: ui-state-architect-board
schema.description: StateArchitectBoard — visual state-machine graph editor: wire transitions between state nodes so every test case reaches its expected state.

emits.description: Player clicks a state node; FSM either selects it, cancels a pending connect, or wires a transition from the pending source.
Player begins wiring a transition from the currently selected state node.
Player removes a transition, identified by its (from, to, event) triple.
Player runs the test suite; the FSM simulates each test case through the transition graph and scores passes.
Reset the puzzle back to the menu.

events.name: Select Node

events.name: Remove Transition
events.description: Player removes a transition, identified by its (from, to, event) triple.

events.name: Run Tests
events.description: Player runs the test suite; the FSM simulates each test case through the transition graph and scores passes.

events.name: Play Again
events.description: Reset the puzzle back to the menu.

variables.label: Variables

description.label: Description

initialState.label: Initial State
initialState.description: The state the machine starts in when a test begins.

availableEvents.label: Available Events
availableEvents.description: Events the player can assign to transitions they add.

testCases.label: Test Cases
testCases.description: Ordered event sequences starting from initialState; must all reach expectedState for a win. Non-empty by default so an empty graph cannot win vacuously.

transitions.label: Transitions
